subject: Post-signature MAP: staggered surge-playbook + evaluation runway
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Brooks <natalie@luminexhealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-06-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-signature MAP: staggered surge-playbook + evaluation runway

Hi Natalie —

Congrats again on signing — excited to get Luminex live. Attached is our working Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that embeds a phased implementation blueprint and an evaluation runway tailored to your volumes. High level summary below and asks to confirm by EOD Wednesday so we can lock resources.

Key pillars (90-day view):
- Canary window (triple-gated): 2029-06-24 to 2029-07-07 — small production traffic routed to Redwood Dedicated pool (owner: Ben).
- Surge-playbook (staggered toggles): progressive ramp steps 10%/35%/75%/100% tied to latency & error gates in the Eval_Runway_Checklist (owner: Grace).
- Migration blackout windows: prefer midnight–04:00 PT on each planned cutover day; propose 2029-07-15 for DB cutover (confirm constraints).
- Training & runbook rehearsal: 2 dry-runs the week before canary with your ops + our CS (agenda attached).
- Acceptance criteria: pass automated perf checks + two business-day sanity with <1% error rate and median 95th p95 latency < 220ms for the canary slice.

Asks / next steps:
1) Confirm the canary start date and whether 2029-06-24 works for your SREs.
2) Procurement: if you can route DocuSign to the link below, we can finalize billing and reserved capacity.
3) Please review the MAP spreadsheet (Luminex_MAP_v0.3.xlsx) and mark any task owners / dependencies.

I've pasted the HubSpot and DocuSign links in metadata for convenience.

Attachments: Luminex_MAP_v0.3.xlsx, Eval_Runway_Checklist.pdf, Training_Rehearsal_Agenda.docx

Thanks — I'll set up a 30m sync once we hear back on dates.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Natalie Brooks <natalie@luminexhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-06-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-signature MAP: staggered surge-playbook + evaluation runway

Thanks Rishi — quick notes inline and a couple of constraints from our ops perspective.

On the canary: 2029-06-24 is feasible for a low-traffic weekday slice; recommend starting at 06:00 PT to avoid overnight detection lag. Ben — can you confirm Dedicated pool sizing for a 10% slice of their peak?

On the surge toggles: I'll attach a short checklist to the shared drive with the gating thresholds (we use token-level SLOs + error budget checks). Suggest we map owners in the MAP spreadsheet by Friday.

Training rehearsals: propose these two slots for your teams — 2029-06-18 09:00–11:00 PT (dry run 1) and 2029-06-21 09:00–11:30 PT (full rehearsal). Natalie — please confirm attendee list and whether Ops will join both.

Procurement / billing: Rishi, FYI procurement often asks for a one-time credit window for initial warm-up. We can discuss a limited onboarding credit (internal approval required).

Quoted from original mail:
> Key pillars (90-day view):
> - Canary window (triple-gated): 2029-06-24 to 2029-07-07 — small production traffic routed to Redwood Dedicated pool (owner: Ben).

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com

From: Natalie Brooks <natalie@luminexhealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@luminexhealth.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-06-06T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-signature MAP: staggered surge-playbook + evaluation runway

Hi Rishi / Grace —

Thanks for the clear plan. A few quick clarifications from Luminex ops & procurement before we lock dates:
1) Acceptance test: can you provide the exact perf test harness we should run (API load profile + seed prompts)? We need this to validate our internal monitoring.
2) DB cutover window: 2029-07-15 midnight–04:00 PT is acceptable but will need a one-hour rollback slot reserved immediately after the window.
3) DocuSign: procurement requests the contract be routed to procurement@luminexhealth.com (I copied team). Please include the reserved-capacity addendum page.
4) Onboarding credit: curious what typical onboarding credits look like (range & duration) and whether they require exec sign-off.

We can confirm training attendees by EOD Friday. For SRE attendance, Alex (cc'd separately) will join the rehearsals.

Thanks — looking forward to the canary.

Best,
Natalie Brooks
VP, Platform Engineering | Luminex Health
Natalie.Brooks@luminexhealth.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Brooks <natalie@luminexhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procure@luminexhealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-06-07T16:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-signature MAP: staggered surge-playbook + evaluation runway

Natalie — thanks, answers inline and actions below.

1) Perf test harness: attached Eval_Runway_Checklist.pdf includes the API load profile (burst + steady), seed prompt set (subset named Luminex_SEED_v2), and the verification script we recommend (curl examples + k6 job). I'll upload the k6 job to the shared Drive folder today.
2) Rollback slot: agreed — we reserve 60 minutes immediately after the 04:00 PT window; I'll add the rollback slot to the MAP and flag it as a hard dependency.
3) DocuSign: using the DocuSign link in metadata — we'll route to procurement@luminexhealth.com and include the reserved-capacity addendum. Procurement team, please confirm the billing contact and PO flow once you receive the envelope.
4) Onboarding credit: Grace — we've historically offered a limited onboarding credit (range 2–6k USD depending on committed capacity) that requires VP approval. I'm looping our Finance approver next if we need a formal exception.

Confirmed rehearsal dates: 2029-06-18 09:00–11:00 PT and 2029-06-21 09:00–11:30 PT. Ben will run the canary sizing checklist on 6/17 to confirm Dedicated pool.

Next steps (action owners):
- Ben Carter: Dedicated pool sizing & canary runbook checklist (due 2029-06-17).
- Natalie / Luminex SRE (Alex): confirm attendee list + internal monitoring tags (due 2029-06-07 EOD).
- Grace O'Connor: gate thresholds & onboarding credit request (internal) (due 2029-06-10).
- Rishi Malhotra: route DocuSign + finalize MAP spreadsheet (done by 2029-06-07).

I'll update the HubSpot record (DEAL-4832) with these milestones and ping when the DocuSign envelope is sent.

Attachments: Luminex_MAP_v0.3.xlsx, Eval_Runway_Checklist.pdf

— Rishi
